finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 section into [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md:3).**

380 commits, mostly dep bumps and refactors. One real feature and ten fixes survived the filter.

Worth a second look: `fix(auth): return 401 instead of 403 for an expired token` is a status-code change, not just a bug fix — flag it to anyone whose client checks for `403` specifically.

Also notable: a request body was being logged in full until `fix(db): stop logging the whole request body` — worth confirming with security whether that needs a mention beyond the changelog.

Next: your call on whether the 401/403 change needs its own Breaking line.
